static_traits.name: He Lei
static_traits.social_status: Tense relationships with colleagues; has one close friend but has not yet confided the current troubles
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no history of psychotherapy or similar psychological problems in the past
static_traits.language_features: Rather negative and self-blaming expression, skeptical about counseling effectiveness (e.g. 'talking is of no use'); showing obvious despair and meaninglessness when discussing work and exam results; tending to avoid communication with colleagues; having some reflective ability but lacking concrete action

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling like a complete failure as a teacher because most students did not pass the final exam, causing strong feelings of failure and the urge to resign.
basic_info.core_demands: I have reached the point of seriously considering resignation, while also realizing these feelings of failure may not be rational, so I am seeking counseling.

core_beliefs: I am a completely useless teacher

special_situations.event: After final exam results were announced, most students had not yet passed
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If students did not pass the exam, it means I am a total failure as a teacher, and it is entirely my responsibility
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constant self-blame and seriously considering resignation to escape the failure situation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is entirely my fault; I am a completely useless teacher

special_situations.event: Thinking of poor grades while working or planning future courses
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot ensure all students pass in the future, my efforts are meaningless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Difficulty concentrating when preparing lessons, reduced engagement, procrastinates concrete analysis and adjustment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My efforts are meaningless; continuing will also be of no use

special_situations.event: When in contact with colleagues or thinking of discussing grades with them
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I talk about the exam results, colleagues will look down on me, thinking I am incompetent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding contact with colleagues to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am a failure

special_situations.event: Considers whether to confide current troubles to close friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express feelings, others will say I am overreacting and will not understand me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Not confiding in others, choosing to bear it alone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will not understand; I should not burden her

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized as a capable and valuable teacher, with meaningful and impactful work
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and being judged / negated by others, worrying about further loss of self-worth
defense_goal: Reducing shame and anxiety by keeping distance and avoiding (not communicating with colleagues / friends)
Considers quitting to escape failure situations and restore a sense of safety

object_relations.object_representation: Others who criticize and look down on oneself (especially colleagues)

object_relations.self_representation: A person who should not burden others, needing to suppress expression
object_relations.object_representation: Others who will not understand and will negate oneself (e.g. friends)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others (including the counselor) invite her to share feelings or suggest seeking support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously believing others will negate one or find one overreacting (transference: projecting inner self-denial onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding in a hesitant and defensive tone, using vague expressions (e.g. 'they will probably say I am exaggerating'), avoiding deep emotions and details.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When encouraged to analyze exams and teaching strategies and take concrete action
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If immediate improvement cannot be ensured, action is meaningless; worrying further failure will intensify shame and judgment
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Listing reasons for inaction in a negative tone (e.g. 'this may also be of no use'), using hypothetical worries to delay or avoid concrete steps.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When facing interactions with colleagues or thinking about colleagues' views of her
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Seeing colleagues as critical others, presuming they will look down on oneself, thereby reinforcing self-blame
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using strongly self-blaming expressions (e.g. 'it is all my fault'), introverted and heavy tone, reducing genuine feeling expression toward others.

manifestations: Feeling 'my efforts are meaningless' while working or planning courses
Exam results make one doubt the value of teaching
Not yet confiding current troubles to close friends

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Believing colleagues will look down on oneself
Presuming friends will say one is overreacting and will not understand

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Using 'talking is of no use' to avoid directly expressing feelings
Replaces concrete problem analysis with generalized failure judgments

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Strong self-blame (e.g. 'I am a useless teacher')
Withdrawing at work, not daring to communicate with colleagues

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Turning help-seeking / communication impulses inward, not confiding, bearing alone
Repressing outward expression under tension and shame

positive_force: Sense of value and love for teaching (once enjoyed students' understanding and progress)
Willing to seek counseling and try small-step actions (agrees to first review the exam questions and lesson plans)
Has problem-solving potential (willing to explore possible causes behind the exam results)
Has one close friend as potential support
negative_force: Marked cognitive distortions such as overgeneralization, black-and-white thinking, and personalization
Strong self-denial and shame, lowering self-efficacy
Social avoidance, support system not yet mobilized
Continuously immersed in thoughts of resigning, action motivation and frustration tolerance decline
Ruminates over exam results; work pressure worsens impaired attention

antecedent: Thinking about or facing discussing exam results with colleagues
When evaluation and comparison cues appear in work settings
target_behavior.core_reason: Over-personalizing students not yet passing the exam and presuming others will negate oneself, avoiding socializing out of shame and fear of being judged
target_behavior.function: Escaping unwelcome stimuli (potential criticism and shame), briefly relieving anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Tense relationships with colleagues, reduced support and collaboration, negative emotions persisting

target_behavior.behavior: When preparing and teaching lessons, finds it hard to concentrate, procrastinates on specific analysis and adjustments
antecedent: Thinking of poor exam results while working or planning future courses
Situations requiring creating or adjusting teaching plans
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative beliefs driven by black-and-white thinking and meaninglessness (if one cannot ensure all students pass, effort is meaningless)
target_behavior.function: Avoiding feelings of failure and further self-denial, briefly reducing psychological load
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance, hindered teaching improvement, deepened negative self-evaluation

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly thinking about resigning and making negative self-statements (e.g. 'I am a completely useless teacher')
antecedent: When recalling exam results or encountering pressure at the workplace
Situations of alone contemplating future career direction
target_behavior.core_reason: Overall failure attribution caused by overgeneralization and personalization, trying to evade failure and judgment through withdrawal
target_behavior.function: Seeking to escape unwelcome situations for short-term control and emotional relief
target_behavior.consequence: Increased resignation risk, hindered career development, further decline in life enjoyment and interpersonal interaction
